--- slide 2: October net sales total is 50.0% above September, but October is missing 2 days: per reported day it is up 55.2%
Metric | October 2026 | September 2026 | Change | Change % | Note
Orders | 20 | 15 | +5 | +33.3% | October partial: 2 days missing; per reported day up 37.9%
Gross sales | $240.00 | $150.00 | +$90.00 | +60.0% | October partial: 2 days missing; per reported day up 65.5%
Refunds | $30.00 | $10.00 | +$20.00 | +200.0% | October partial: 2 days missing; per reported day up 210.3%
Net sales | $210.00 | $140.00 | +$70.00 | +50.0% | October partial: 2 days missing; per reported day up 55.2%
Average order value | $12.00 | $10.00 | +$2.00 | +20.0% | October partial: 2 days missing
Buyers per active day | 8.0 | 6.5 | +1.5 | +23.1% | October partial: 2 days missing
Source: the store's daily order records.
Change % is the change over September's figure, n/a when that was zero. Buyers per active day is the average of each day's distinct buyers, over days with orders. Average order value is gross sales divided by orders.
Per reported day divides a total by the days with orders plus the days with no orders, so months with different numbers of days with data can be compared.

Day of the month across. Left: website sessions. Right: orders. The grey line is the month before.
Sessions: a dot on the zero line is a day with no sessions reported, a break with an X is a day with no data (Oct 5, Oct 6).

--- slide 6: October sessions total is 36.7% above September, but October is missing 2 days of website data: per reported day it is up 41.4%
Metric | October 2026 | September 2026 | Change | Change % | Note
Sessions | 410 | 300 | +110 | +36.7% | October: 2 days missing; per reported day up 41.4%
Users per active day | 150.0 | 115.0 | +35.0 | +30.4% | October: 2 days missing
Page views | 1,100 | 850 | +250 | +29.4% | October: 2 days missing; per reported day up 33.9%
Key events | 20 | 15 | +5 | +33.3% | October: 2 days missing; per reported day up 37.9%
Order rate | 4.9% | 5.0% | -0.1 pts | -2.4% | October: 2 days missing; 27 days in both
Sessions against orders by week
Week | Days counted | Sessions | Orders | Order rate
Oct 1 to 7 | 5 of 7 | 410 | 20 | 4.9%
Oct 8 to 14 | 5 of 7 | 0 | 0 | n/a
Oct 15 to 21 | 7 of 7 | 0 | 0 | n/a
Oct 22 to 28 | 7 of 7 | 0 | 0 | n/a
Oct 29 to 31 | 3 of 3 | 0 | 0 | n/a
Source: the website's Google Analytics 4 daily figures. Website days follow the property's own time zone, store days follow UTC.
Users per active day is the average of each day's distinct users. Order rate is orders divided by sessions over the days both sources reported, not a Google Analytics conversion rate.
Per reported day divides a total by the days with traffic plus the days with no traffic.

--- slide 8: Data health: October is missing 2 days of store data and 2 days of website data
Count | Store, October | Store, September | Website, October | Website, September
Days in the month | 31 | 30 | 31 | 30
Days with data | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2
Days with nothing to report | 27 | 28 | 27 | 28
Days with no data | 2 | 0 | 2 | 0
Stored daily figures used | 12 | 12 | 8 | 8
Days with no data in October, store: Oct 10, Oct 11.
Days with no data in October, website: Oct 5, Oct 6.
Days with no data in September, store: none.
Days with no data in September, website: none.
A month with days missing is understated, so its changes are marked partial.
For each source, days with data, days with nothing to report and days with no data add up to the days in the month.
A day with nothing to report is one where a data pull ran and found none. A day with no data is one no data pull covered.
